RESOLVED 2026-08-13 - grammar conformance is now machine-checked. History: the per-story ladder was authored by the agent, never compared against any external source, and was wrong in BOTH directions - it banned A1 material (basic reflexives, basic interrogatives) and taught A2 material as if it were A1. Nothing ever checked it. Settled against the Instituto Cervantes PCIC A1-A2 inventory by codex gpt-5.6-sol (_planning/pcic-ladder-table.md, _planning/pcic-ruling.md). Owner retitled the volume A2 rather than rewrite it (constitution amendment log). BUILT: tooling/scripts/spanish_grammar_check.py - stdlib only, forms generated from a declared lemma set rather than ending heuristics (483 of 558 manuscript tokens end in something verb-shaped, so endings are useless as a verb detector). Pinned by tests/test_spanish_grammar_gate.py (17 tests). ALL TEN CONTRACTS rebuilt from PCIC with per-construct levels; interrogatives moved to story 01 where PCIC puts them and the prose uses them; story 09 now licenses irregular preterite BY LEMMA in 1sg/3sg, matching its own prose (dije/pude). PROSE DEFECTS FOUND AND FIXED by the new checker or by the PCIC audit: 'Le gusta' x2 in story 01 and 'no le gusta' in story 02 (gustar belongs to story 06); 'no va a contestar' in story 02 (ir a + inf belongs to story 05); 'Mientras' in story 03 (simultaneity belongs to story 07); 'Escriba' x2 in stories 03/04 (imperative, absent from the book); 'Antes es de el' in story 03 (present doing a past tense's job - a correctness bug). TWO FALSE POSITIVES in the checker's first run were themselves bugs, both fixed and pinned: 'desaparecer' filed as -ar so 'desaparece' read as an imperative, and interrogatives detected by 'does this file contain a question mark' instead of by the accent, so the subordinator in 'cuando Ana vuelve' was flagged. STATUS: vocabulary gate 10/10, grammar gate 10/10, 39 tests green. CEILING, stated rather than implied: the checker is LINT, not certification. It reads forms and patterns and CANNOT see temporal misuse ('Antes es de el') or future-value present ('manana viene'); habitual present is likewise undetectable from morphology. Two constructs - interrogative 'cuando' and 'mientras' - cannot be levelled from the PCIC page at all and carry recorded house decisions, never PCIC-backed claims. Do not describe the ladder as CEFR-certified anywhere reader-facing.
